introduce:
Lie on your back with arms at sides, palms down and legs extended. 

Lift your legs and cross the right thigh over the left, then reverse the exercise. 

Make sure your back is always flat.

It's a great exercise for the obliques and rectus abdominis.
name: SCISSORS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Slightly bend your knees.
Breathe naturally.
To make it easier, place your hands under your glutes to get more balance.
This exercise primarily targets your lower abs.
This exercise can help you get great balance.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees up at a 90 degree angle. 

Extend your arms to the sides and put your palms down on the ground. 

Twist your legs to the left while keeping your upper body in place and your knees and feet together. 

Hold it for one second, then return and twist to the other side. Repeat the exercise.
name: BENT LEG TWIST

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please do it slowly to get better results.
Please make sure your knees and feet are together.
Please tighten your abs during the entire exercise.
Please keep your knees at a 90 degree angle.
Please don\'t rotate your legs to the point where your opposite arm can no longer stay on the floor.
This exercise targets your core muscles.

introduce: Sit down with your hands behind you on the ground, your legs extended and your upper body leaning backward. \n\nBend your knees, and bring them toward your chest; then fully extend your legs without touching the ground. Repeat the exercise.
name: LEG IN & OUTS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your back straight.
Please do it slowly to feel the squeezing.
Exhale when bringing your knees to your chest, and inhale when extending your legs.
Please don\'t touch the ground when you extend your leg.
